# Biology Insights

> > A comprehensive resource exploring diverse biological systems across animal behavior, cellular biology, biotechnology, and ecology.

Biology Insights covers a wide range of topics from microscopic cellular structures to macroscopic animal behaviors and biotechnology applications. The site features in-depth guides on disease models, regeneration biology, and sustainable cultivation methods alongside engaging articles on animal communication and ecology.

## Key Topics

- Zebrafish
- Beetles
- Oysters
- Rabbits
- Locusts
- Birds
- microalgae
- macroalgae
- photobioreactors
- neurons
- animal-behavior
- disease-models
- regeneration
- algae-cultivation
- biotechnology-research

## Cellular and Neural Biology

- [Normal Brain Tissue: Structure, Cells, and Function](https://biologyinsights.com/normal-brain-tissue-structure-cells-and-function): Educational guide on brain tissue: neurons, glial cells, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes.

## Regeneration and Disease Models

- [Zebrafish Eye: Regeneration and Human Disease Models](https://biologyinsights.com/zebrafish-eye-regeneration-and-human-disease-models): Guide to zebrafish eye regeneration, photoreceptors, rods, cones as disease models.

## Biotechnology and Algae Cultivation

- [What Is Algae Cultivation and How Does It Work?](https://biologyinsights.com/what-is-algae-cultivation-and-how-does-it-work): Guide to algae cultivation using microalgae, macroalgae, photobioreactors, and LED lamps.

## Animal Behavior and Communication

- [Beetle Sounds: How They're Made and What They Mean](https://biologyinsights.com/beetle-sounds-how-theyre-made-and-what-they-mean): Article on beetle acoustics: deathwatch beetles, bark beetles, stridulation, and communication.
- [What Causes Locust Migration and Swarms?](https://biologyinsights.com/what-causes-locust-migration-and-swarms): Article on locust swarming, serotonin, phenotypic plasticity, and agricultural impacts.
- [Why Do Birds Chirp Before a Storm?](https://biologyinsights.com/why-do-birds-chirp-before-a-storm): Article on bird vocalizations, atmospheric pressure detection, and storm behavior.

## Marine and Invertebrate Biology

- [Do Oysters Have Blood and a Circulatory System?](https://biologyinsights.com/do-oysters-have-blood-and-a-circulatory-system): Article on oyster hemolymph, hemocyanin, hemocytes, and open circulatory systems.

## Vertebrate Biology and Human Health

- [The Rabbit Human Relationship: Pets, Health, and Culture](https://biologyinsights.com/the-rabbit-human-relationship-pets-health-and-culture): Article on rabbit breeds, pet care, zoonotic diseases, and human-animal bonds.

## Core Resources

- [Biology Insights](https://biologyinsights.com): Homepage showcasing diverse biology topics: zebrafish, beetles, oysters, rabbits, locusts.
